name: Runner Extras - Nested Transaction Commit Point
brief: Regression for issue #2413: a BC API that opens a PLAIN nested transaction (Query.Open, statement-form XmlPort.Import) was treated as a durable commit point, so an asserterror stopped rolling back writes made before it. Only a completed transaction WORLD (guarded Codeunit.Run, Ok := XmlPort.Import) is a commit.
description: The BC-language contract this exercises - which nested BC transactions move the rollback boundary and which do not - is a plain BC-behaviour claim and belongs upstream in the al-language corpus (see the runner repo's bc-behavior-tests-go-upstream.md); every shape here was measured on a real BC 28.4 service tier before the issue was filed, in both directions (the plain-transaction shapes roll back, the transaction-world shapes stay). This suite is the runner-repo-local stopgap so this repo's own CI gates the fix now; once the corpus test lands and the pin moves it may be retired.
